## Who we are

### Align Technology is a global medical device company that is changing lives through better
### smiles. We reimagine and reinvent the way orthodontic and restorative treatment is presented and
### delivered to millions of people around the world.

The Invisalign® System is the most advanced clear aligner system in the world, trusted by over 22
million people worldwide to improve their smiles.

[Learn more][17]

iTero™ intraoral scanners can propel today's dental practice into the future by enhancing the
patient experience and elevating clinical precision.

[Learn more][18]

 

## Key metrics

# ~$4.1B

#### Annualized net revenues

# ~22.8M

#### Invisalign® Patients, including ~6.8M teens and kids

# 2,319

#### Active patents

# +20K

#### Global Employees

[Joe Hogan, President and CEO]

### CEO 2026 Letter to Shareholders

As I reflect on fiscal 2025, I am proud of how Align navigated a year that demanded focus,
resilience, and disciplined execution. The operating environment remained uneven across regions,
consumer demand was pressured in parts of the world, and we made difficult organizational decisions
to better position the company for the future. Yet through these challenges, our teams stayed
anchored to what matters most—serving doctors and their patients—and delivered a strong finish to
the year.

[Link to CEO letter][19]

## Careers

### As a part of our smart, diverse and fast-moving global team, you'll make an impact for a leader
### in innovation that's moving an industry forward.

[Learn more][20]

applications, featuring trusted and established brands.

A must-read for every implantologist.

Prof. Tomas Albrektsson and 30+ experts celebrate 60 years of dental implants.

[ Buy now ][127] [ Discover more ][128]

## **Explore Nobel Biocare**
* [Nobel Biocare implant systems]
  
  ## [
  ## Implant systems
  ## ][129]
  
  Practice perfection. Discover the next-generation N1™ system and other clinically proven dental
  implant systems.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Polo scan bodies]
  
  ## [
  ## PoLo Multi-unit abutments
  ## ][130]
  
  Our smartly designed modular scan body system for partial or full arches that sits on multi-unit
  abutments.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Trays]
  
  ## [
  ## PureSet™ and LiteSet™ Trays
  ## ][131]
  
  From robust stainless-steel PureSet trays to compact LiteSet trays, we provide an option that
  keeps your instruments secure, protected, and ready to use.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Custom prosthetics]
  
  ## [
  ## Prosthetics
  ## ][132]
  
  Efficiency. Results. Streamline your restorative workflow with solutions from Nobel Biocare.
  
  **Learn more >**
* ## [
  ## Regenerative solutions
  ## ][133]
  
  Overcome the most challenging indications with Nobel Biocare’s portfolio of premium regeneratives.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Nobel Biocare oral surgeons in an education course]
  
  ## [
  ## Community
  ## ][134]
  
  We’re with you at every stage of your implant dentistry journey. Explore Nobel Biocare workshops,
  lectures, training, and CE opportunities.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Nobel Biocare SciConnect]
  
  ## [
  ## SciConnect
  ## ][135]
  
  Read up on the latest clinical cases, implant dentistry news, and upcoming continuing education
  opportunities.
  
  **Learn more >**
* ## [
  ## Product catalog
  ## ][136]
  
  The 2024/2025 product catalog contains all our products, from implants to digital solutions. Ask
  your sales rep to get your printed copy or download the digital version here.
  
  **Learn more >**
* [Nobel Biocare customer service representative]
  
  ## [
  ## Let’s talk
  ## ][137]
  
  Have a question about an order? Looking to schedule a discussion to learn about the latest digital
  dentistry tools? Connect with a representative today!
  
  **Learn more >**

## **Clinical solutions**

All Nobel Biocare products are firmly rooted in two core foundations: science and innovation.

[ Discover our clinical solutions ][138]

## **Lab solutions**

Precision-engineered and manufactured solutions.

[ Discover our lab solutions ][139]
[Nobel Biocare smile]

## **Innovation with purpose**

Nobel Biocare champions solutions that help clinicians treat patients better. Our excellence is
defined in over 4,500 published scientific articles. Our legacy is built on 50-plus years of
successful patient care that has seen over 20 million smiles rehabilitated.

[ Learn more ][140]

“The [**All-on-4® digital workflow**][141] has truly transformed the practice! By streamlining
processes and enhancing precision, you’re not only improving patient outcomes but also boosting team
efficiency.”

[Dr. Joe Mehranfar]
Dr. Joe Mehranfar, United States

Nobel Biocare champions solutions that help clinicians treat patients better. Our excellence is
defined in over 4,500 published scientific articles. Our legacy is built on 50-plus years of
successful patient care that has seen over 20 million smiles rehabilitated.

technology and consists of several companies. Planmeca Group companies manufacture and supply

Planmeca Oy is the parent company of Planmeca Group, which operates in the field of healthcare
technology and consists of several companies. Planmeca Group companies manufacture and supply
state-of-the-art dental care equipment and instruments, dental and medical imaging devices and
software, as well as mammography systems. Planmeca Group also includes companies providing dental
supplies, services and education.

##### FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

Here you will find answers to the most frequently asked question. If you don’t find what you’re
looking for, feel free to contact us directly. We are always happy to assist you.

How much is teeth cleaning in manila

Standard prices of teeth cleaning procedures in Manila ranges from 700 to 1,500 pesos depending on
the your dentist. It’s best to check and compare different prices offered by your nearby dental
clinics, and also ensure that you are choosing licensed and qualified professional.

Can you keep your teeth healthy without a dentist?

Absolutely, keeping a good oral hygiene and health are should be a priority with or without a
dentist. However, there are certain cases and dental procedures that may require professional
assistance to aid your dental problems. Keep your teeth healthy at home by:
* Brushing your teeth regularly.
* Eating a healthy diet. Preferably low in sugar and avoid snacking between meals.
* Limit tobacco, and alcohol consumption.
* Drinking plenty of water to keep yourself hydrated.
* Keep dental floss into your oral hygiene routine.

Is Dentist covered by PhilHealth?

Reviewing the complete list of covered services with PhilHealth or your health insurance provider
ensures a comprehensive coverage for your dental needs. It’s crucial to consider that the extent of
PhilHealth coverage may vary based on your membership category and insurance plan. Contact us at
Alora Dental Clinic to learn more.

What food kills mouth bacteria?

Foods should only be a complementary but not a substitute for a good oral hygiene practices like
regularly brushing your teeth, flossing, and dental check-ups. Nevertheless, here are some of the
foods that can help fight mouth bacteria:
* Crunchy fruits and vegetables like apples and carrots.
* Dairy products like cheese and yogurt.
* Foods that are high in vitamin c, such as citrus fruits.
* Green and black teas.
* Foods that are high in calcium and phosphorus, such as almonds, are excellent at strengthening
  tooth enamel and supporting oral health.

How many times should you get your teeth cleaned?

Teeth cleaning frequency recommendation depends on each individual’s oral health cases. For someone
who regularly visits their dentist and has good oral health hygiene habits, ones or twice a year is
enough. However, for those with gum disease, cavities, and other dental concerns, may required a
frequency of every 3 to 4 months. It’s best to consult your dentist for personalized
recommendations.

Do deep cleanings hurt?

The level of discomfort from deep cleaning varies from person to person, but if properly done, the
procedure shouldn’t be painful. If you are concerned about this during a deep cleaning session, it’s
best to let your dentist know about your concerns and any options to increase comfort.

Can mouthwash remove tartar?

Mouthwash may prevent the buildup of plaque, a film of bacteria that can cause tartar formation, but
it cannot eliminate tartar that has already formed on teeth. Make sure to schedule an appointment
with your dentist for expert recommendations.

What is the best time to see the dentist?

To maintain optimal oral health, it is advised to schedule regular dental check-ups and cleanings at
least twice a year. By doing so, any potential dental problems can be detected early and treated
promptly, ensuring healthy teeth and gums.

How do I calm my nerves before a dentist appointment?

For some individuals, a dental appointment can evoke feelings of anxiety due to past traumatic
experiences or memories of pain. A good way to ease your nerves before an appointment are practicing
deep breathing, listening to music, bringing a friend or family, and being open with your dentist.
Alora Dental Clinic prioritizes every patient’s comfort and promote a stress-free procedure as much
as possible.

What damages teeth the most?

There are several factors that can contribute to a damage teeth. Some of the common culprits are
poor oral hygiene, sugary foods, acidic foods, tobacco use, excessive grinding and clenching. By
avoiding these factors, you can lessen the risk of damaging your teeth.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Here you will find answers to the most frequently asked question. If you don’t find what you’re
looking for, feel free to contact us directly. We are always happy to assist you.

How much is teeth cleaning in manila

Standard prices of teeth cleaning procedures in Manila ranges from 700 to 1,500 pesos depending on
the your dentist. It’s best to check and compare different prices offered by your nearby dental
clinics, and also ensure that you are choosing licensed and qualified professional.

Can you keep your teeth healthy without a dentist?

Absolutely, keeping a good oral hygiene and health are should be a priority with or without a
dentist. However, there are certain cases and dental procedures that may require professional
assistance to aid your dental problems. Keep your teeth healthy at home by:
* Brushing your teeth regularly.
* Eating a healthy diet. Preferably low in sugar and avoid snacking between meals.
* Limit tobacco, and alcohol consumption.
* Drinking plenty of water to keep yourself hydrated.
* Keep dental floss into your oral hygiene routine.

Is Dentist covered by PhilHealth?

Reviewing the complete list of covered services with PhilHealth or your health insurance provider
ensures a comprehensive coverage for your dental needs. It’s crucial to consider that the extent of
PhilHealth coverage may vary based on your membership category and insurance plan. Contact us at
Alora Dental Clinic to learn more.

What food kills mouth bacteria?

Foods should only be a complementary but not a substitute for a good oral hygiene practices like
regularly brushing your teeth, flossing, and dental check-ups. Nevertheless, here are some of the
foods that can help fight mouth bacteria:
* Crunchy fruits and vegetables like apples and carrots.
* Dairy products like cheese and yogurt.
* Foods that are high in vitamin c, such as citrus fruits.
* Green and black teas.
* Foods that are high in calcium and phosphorus, such as almonds, are excellent at strengthening
  tooth enamel and supporting oral health.

How many times should you get your teeth cleaned?

Teeth cleaning frequency recommendation depends on each individual’s oral health cases. For someone
who regularly visits their dentist and has good oral health hygiene habits, ones or twice a year is
enough. However, for those with gum disease, cavities, and other dental concerns, may required a
frequency of every 3 to 4 months. It’s best to consult your dentist for personalized
recommendations.

Do deep cleanings hurt?

The level of discomfort from deep cleaning varies from person to person, but if properly done, the
procedure shouldn’t be painful. If you are concerned about this during a deep cleaning session, it’s
best to let your dentist know about your concerns and any options to increase comfort.

Can mouthwash remove tartar?

Mouthwash may prevent the buildup of plaque, a film of bacteria that can cause tartar formation, but
it cannot eliminate tartar that has already formed on teeth. Make sure to schedule an appointment
with your dentist for expert recommendations.

What is the best time to see the dentist?

To maintain optimal oral health, it is advised to schedule regular dental check-ups and cleanings at
least twice a year. By doing so, any potential dental problems can be detected early and treated
promptly, ensuring healthy teeth and gums.

How do I calm my nerves before a dentist appointment?

For some individuals, a dental appointment can evoke feelings of anxiety due to past traumatic
experiences or memories of pain. A good way to ease your nerves before an appointment are practicing
deep breathing, listening to music, bringing a friend or family, and being open with your dentist.
Alora Dental Clinic prioritizes every patient’s comfort and promote a stress-free procedure as much
as possible.

What damages teeth the most?

There are several factors that can contribute to a damage teeth. Some of the common culprits are
poor oral hygiene, sugary foods, acidic foods, tobacco use, excessive grinding and clenching. By
avoiding these factors, you can lessen the risk of damaging your teeth.

### You deserve a beautiful smile

In our practice, you will discover contemporary dental care designed for your complete satisfaction.

### The History Of Dental Care

The history of dental care is as rich and fascinating as the stories behind every smile. Imagine
living thousands of years ago, when the first "dentists" were more like brave experimenters with
rudimentary tools. In ancient Egypt, they were already filling cavities and creating prosthetic
teeth with impressive ingenuity. Fast forward to ancient Greece and Rome, where thinkers like
Hippocrates were studying oral health and crafting the earliest versions of dental care techniques.
It’s almost like the ancient world was writing the first chapters of a book we’re still reading
today—filled with trial, error, and remarkable breakthroughs.

As time marched on, dental care evolved from a crude necessity to an advanced science. By the Middle
Ages, barber-surgeons were pulling double duty, cutting hair and extracting teeth, often in the same
sitting. Then came the Renaissance, a time of rebirth—not just for art and culture, but for
dentistry too. Enter Pierre Fauchard, the “Father of Modern Dentistry,” who turned dentistry into a
recognized profession with his groundbreaking book The Surgeon Dentist. From these humble
beginnings, dentistry blossomed into the high-tech, patient-focused field we know today, combining
science, art, and a touch of compassion to keep our smiles healthy and bright.

#### Common Concerns, Conditions, And Issues

Dentists are like the Swiss Army knives of oral health—they’re equipped to handle a wide variety of
concerns, keeping your smile in top shape. One of the most common issues they treat is tooth decay,
which is as pesky as it sounds. Cavities can sneak up on anyone, but a dentist is ready to stop them
in their tracks with fillings or crowns. Gum disease, another frequent offender, is also on their
radar. Whether it’s mild gingivitis or more severe periodontitis, general dentists can provide
treatments to protect your gums and preserve your teeth. And let’s not forget about everyday
nuisances like tooth sensitivity, bad breath, or that random chipped tooth—they’ve got solutions for
all of it.

But their expertise doesn’t stop at quick fixes. General dentists are also your first line of
defense against more complex conditions. They diagnose and manage oral infections, TMJ disorders,
and even the occasional sleep apnea-related issue. Think you grind your teeth at night? They can
create custom mouthguards to save your teeth from unnecessary wear and tear. From preventive
cleanings to restorative care, general dentists tackle it all, ensuring your smile is not just
healthy but strong enough to take on whatever life throws your way.

#### What Kind Of Training Does A Dentist Have?

Becoming a dentist isn’t just about learning how to fix teeth—it’s about mastering a blend of
science, art, and people skills. The journey starts with earning a bachelor’s degree, usually
focused on sciences like biology or chemistry, which lays the foundation for understanding the human
body. Then comes dental school, an intense four-year program where students dive into everything
from anatomy and oral health to hands-on training with real patients. It’s like boot camp for your
smile’s best advocate, combining book smarts with practical skills to ensure dentists can handle any
situation, from routine cleaning to a tricky root canal.

But the training doesn’t stop there. Many dentists pursue additional specialties, like orthodontics
or oral surgery, which can add several years of rigorous education and clinical practice. Even
general dentists constantly keep their skills sharp with continuing education, staying updated on
the latest techniques and technologies. Think of it like a never-ending quest to be the best at what
they do. So, when you sit in that chair, you’re not just getting care from someone who “knows
teeth”—you’re trusting an expert who’s spent years perfecting their craft to give you the
healthiest, brightest smile possible.

### You deserve a beautiful smile

In our practice, you will discover contemporary dental care designed for your complete satisfaction.
We believe that teeth should look great, function properly, and withstand the rigors of daily life.
Dr. Joseph Wetherhold and the team at Alta Dental of Maine combine the science of restoring teeth
with artistic vision in cosmetic dentistry to produce strong, beautiful smiles.

### The History Of Dental Care

The history of dental care is as rich and fascinating as the stories behind every smile. Imagine
living thousands of years ago, when the first "dentists" were more like brave experimenters with
rudimentary tools. In ancient Egypt, they were already filling cavities and creating prosthetic
teeth with impressive ingenuity. Fast forward to ancient Greece and Rome, where thinkers like
Hippocrates were studying oral health and crafting the earliest versions of dental care techniques.
It’s almost like the ancient world was writing the first chapters of a book we’re still reading
today—filled with trial, error, and remarkable breakthroughs.

As time marched on, dental care evolved from a crude necessity to an advanced science. By the Middle
Ages, barber-surgeons were pulling double duty, cutting hair and extracting teeth, often in the same
sitting. Then came the Renaissance, a time of rebirth—not just for art and culture, but for
dentistry too. Enter Pierre Fauchard, the “Father of Modern Dentistry,” who turned dentistry into a
recognized profession with his groundbreaking book The Surgeon Dentist. From these humble
beginnings, dentistry blossomed into the high-tech, patient-focused field we know today, combining
science, art, and a touch of compassion to keep our smiles healthy and bright.

FAQS

## Answers to some frequently asked questions.

How does Arini's implementation process work?

Integrate: We meet with your IT to integrate to your practice management software, which allows us
to manage your schedule.
‍

Teach: An Arini implementation Engineer onboards your practice by customizing your scheduling rules,
verbiage, call flow, and more.
‍

Test: You test your custom instance and make edits as you wish.
‍

Go live: We start taking real patients calls, monitor your calls, and make sure you have a smooth
transition!

Is Arini compatible with my practice management software and phone system?

Yes, Arini seamlessly integrates with the vast majority of dental practice management software and
phone providers. Our practices use OpenDental, EagleSoft, Denticon, and many more. In terms of phone
providers, we have practices using Weave, Mango, GoTo, Jive, RevenueWealth PBX, Telco and more.

How secure is Arini's technology?

At Arini, we prioritize data security and privacy. Our system is 100% HIPAA compliant and we follow
the principle of least privilege and strict role-based permissions for data access. We use strong
encryption protocols for data transmission and have a [Trust Center][42] that continuously monitors
our compliance. Our board of technical advisors took companies from inception to IPO in the dental
industry.

FAQS

## Answers to some frequently asked questions.

How does Arini's implementation process work?

Integrate: We meet with your IT to integrate to your practice management software, which allows us
to manage your schedule.
‍

Teach: An Arini implementation Engineer onboards your practice by customizing your scheduling rules,
verbiage, call flow, and more.
‍

Test: You test your custom instance and make edits as you wish.
‍

Go live: We start taking real patients calls, monitor your calls, and make sure you have a smooth
transition!

Is Arini compatible with my practice management software and phone system?

Yes, Arini seamlessly integrates with the vast majority of dental practice management software and
phone providers. Our practices use OpenDental, EagleSoft, Denticon, and many more. In terms of phone
providers, we have practices using Weave, Mango, GoTo, Jive, RevenueWealth PBX, Telco and more.

How secure is Arini's technology?

At Arini, we prioritize data security and privacy. Our system is 100% HIPAA compliant and we follow
the principle of least privilege and strict role-based permissions for data access. We use strong
encryption protocols for data transmission and have a [Trust Center][42] that continuously monitors
our compliance. Our board of technical advisors took companies from inception to IPO in the dental
industry.

## **A New Chapter in South Pasadena**

After many cherished years in our Altadena office, we are excited to welcome you to our new home in
South Pasadena. Over time, our practice grew in ways our old space could no longer support, and this
move allows us to better serve you with room to breathe, grow, and thrive together.

Our new office is located on historic Mission St. and is modern and thoughtfully designed, offering
the latest amenities to make your visits more comfortable and your care more seamless. From a clean,
bright environment to advanced technology that supports exceptional dentistry, every detail reflects
our dedication to giving you the very best.

This transition also represents a fresh start following the Eaton Fire. That season reminded us of
the strength of our community and the importance of resilience. We are deeply grateful for the
support of our community and look forward to moving ahead with renewed purpose and energy.

Most of all, we look forward to welcoming you into our new space — a place where you and your family
can feel at home, and where we can continue building lasting connections rooted in trust,
compassion, and excellent care.  We hope to see you very soon!

## Comfortable Dentistry in South Pasadena

### Down-to-Earth, Up-to-Date Care

At our office, we take an educational approach to dental care because our goal is to empower
patients of all ages to maintain optimal oral health. We offer more than just single-tooth
dentistry, and if you have a dental issue we treat the underlying cause rather than just the
symptoms. At Arroyo Haven Dentistry, we’re proud to offer comprehensive care for your total smile
and your entire family! Call us today for quality dental care in South Pasadena!

[[A picture of an orange background with the words aroyo haven.]][27]

## **Our Mission at Arroyo Haven Dentistry**

Our Mission is to provide the highest quality of care and education, personalized to each
individual’s needs. We treat everyone (patients and team members) in our safe space with kindness,
compassion, patience, humility, and respect. We welcome open communication and transparency in what
we do.

## Our Vision

To provide our patients a dental experience that promotes a lifelong relationship built on trust,
confidence, and quality of work.

We are committed to being lifelong learners, evolving and growing in our professional skills through
continuing education.

We dedicate ourselves to be the best for each other and those we care for.

#### Frenectomies

Watching your infant struggle to breastfeed/bottle feed, or experiencing your own discomfort while
breastfeeding can be overwhelming. If a tongue tie procedure is necessary, Dr. Bethany utilizes a
CO2 laser to provide a gentle release. The short procedure gives your baby the opportunity for a
better feeding experience and more.

[Learn More][28][Find
Relief][29]

#### Implants

Missing teeth can negatively affect more than just the aesthetics of your smile. Tooth loss can lead
to other dental issues like shifting teeth and jaw bone resorption. Dental implants are the only
replacement option that prevent these issues and completely restore your smile.

‍


[Replace Missing Teeth][30][Learn More][31]

#### Crowns

If your tooth has been damaged by decay or cracked in an oral injury, a dental crown can repair it
and prevent further damage. Crowns are meant to cover up the exterior surface of your tooth all the
way down to the gumline, and they look and feel completely natural.


‍


[Restore Tooth Structure][32][Learn More][33]

#### Fillings

Even with the best oral hygiene routine, cavities can still occur. If your teeth have been affected
by decay, we offer natural-looking composite fillings to repair the damage and get you back to
smiling again. If you suspect that you have a cavity, call today to book a visit for a filling!

‍


[Treat
Cavities][34][Learn More][35]

## Craig D. Cheng, D.D.S.

Dr. Craig has always known that he wanted to be a dentist. Growing up, he was fortunate to have a
family dentist who was upbeat and energetic, and never made dental care feel intimidating. Dr. Craig
takes the same personable, genuine approach to dental care, so you will always feel at home in his
chair!

[More About Dr. Craig][36

## **A New Chapter in South Pasadena**

After many cherished years in our Altadena office, we are excited to welcome you to our new home in
South Pasadena. Over time, our practice grew in ways our old space could no longer support, and this
move allows us to better serve you with room to breathe, grow, and thrive together.

Our new office is located on historic Mission St. and is modern and thoughtfully designed, offering
the latest amenities to make your visits more comfortable and your care more seamless. From a clean,
bright environment to advanced technology that supports exceptional dentistry, every detail reflects
our dedication to giving you the very best.

This transition also represents a fresh start following the Eaton Fire. That season reminded us of
the strength of our community and the importance of resilience. We are deeply grateful for the
support of our community and look forward to moving ahead with renewed purpose and energy.

Most of all, we look forward to welcoming you into our new space — a place where you and your family
can feel at home, and where we can continue building lasting connections rooted in trust,
compassion, and excellent care.  We hope to see you very soon!

## Comfortable Dentistry in South Pasadena

### Down-to-Earth, Up-to-Date Care

At our office, we take an educational approach to dental care because our goal is to empower
patients of all ages to maintain optimal oral health. We offer more than just single-tooth
dentistry, and if you have a dental issue we treat the underlying cause rather than just the
symptoms. At Arroyo Haven Dentistry, we’re proud to offer comprehensive care for your total smile
and your entire family! Call us today for quality dental care in South Pasadena!

[[A picture of an orange background with the words aroyo haven.]][27]

## **Our Mission at Arroyo Haven Dentistry**

Our Mission is to provide the highest quality of care and education, personalized to each
individual’s needs. We treat everyone (patients and team members) in our safe space with kindness,
compassion, patience, humility, and respect. We welcome open communication and transparency in what
we do.

## Our Vision

To provide our patients a dental experience that promotes a lifelong relationship built on trust,
confidence, and quality of work.

We are committed to being lifelong learners, evolving and growing in our professional skills through
continuing education.

We dedicate ourselves to be the best for each other and those we care for.

#### Frenectomies

Watching your infant struggle to breastfeed/bottle feed, or experiencing your own discomfort while
breastfeeding can be overwhelming. If a tongue tie procedure is necessary, Dr. Bethany utilizes a
CO2 laser to provide a gentle release. The short procedure gives your baby the opportunity for a
better feeding experience and more.

[Learn More][28][Find
Relief][29]

#### Implants

Missing teeth can negatively affect more than just the aesthetics of your smile. Tooth loss can lead
to other dental issues like shifting teeth and jaw bone resorption. Dental implants are the only
replacement option that prevent these issues and completely restore your smile.

‍


[Replace Missing Teeth][30][Learn More][31]

#### Crowns

If your tooth has been damaged by decay or cracked in an oral injury, a dental crown can repair it
and prevent further damage. Crowns are meant to cover up the exterior surface of your tooth all the
way down to the gumline, and they look and feel completely natural.


‍


[Restore Tooth Structure][32][Learn More][33]

#### Fillings

Even with the best oral hygiene routine, cavities can still occur. If your teeth have been affected
by decay, we offer natural-looking composite fillings to repair the damage and get you back to
smiling again. If you suspect that you have a cavity, call today to book a visit for a filling!

‍


[Treat
Cavities][34][Learn More][35]

## Craig D. Cheng, D.D.S.

Dr. Craig has always known that he wanted to be a dentist. Growing up, he was fortunate to have a
family dentist who was upbeat and energetic, and never made dental care feel intimidating. Dr. Craig
takes the same personable, genuine approach to dental care, so you will always feel at home in his
chair!

[More About Dr. Craig][36

welcoming environment. We focus on ensuring that you, and your child, leave our office with a
healthy and beautiful smile. With over 35 years of experience and the latest in dental technology,
our team is equipped to provide the best dental care possible.

Dr. Byrne and Dr. Byrne the junior, have helped thousands of patients with medical discomfort and
cosmetic repairs. From pediatric care, to implant restorations providing excellent care is all in a
days work for these generational dentists. Providing our patients with the smile they’ve always
wanted is the reason our patients love us and continue to return for years and generation to come.

**
La Grange Dentist | Byrne Family Dentistry | 1-502-222-1494
3108 S. Highway 53 La Grange, Kentucky**

* #### [COSMETIC DENTISTRY][23]
  
  Physical appearance is the most obvious benefit, but your physical, emotional, and mental health
  is also improved thanks to cosmetic dentistry.
* #### [PEDIATRIC DENTISTRY][24]
  
  Preventing cavities and other problems at a young age will set your child down a path to having
  strong teeth and gums when they get older.
* #### [ROOT CANAL][25]
  
  A root canal involves removing the deteriorated pulp from the root of the tooth and stabilizing
  the tooth with filler.
* #### [PREVENTATIVE DENTISTRY][26]
  
  Prevent bacteria buildup and avoid tooth loss by scheduling routine professional cleanings and
  dental exams at an early age to keep your teeth, gums, and mouth as healthy as possible.
* #### [ORAL HYGIENE][27]
  
  You already know that maintaining good oral hygiene and scheduling teeth cleanings is important to
  keeping you teeth strong and healthy.
* #### [IMPLANT RESTORATION][28]
  
  It’s important to maintain your implants so they don’t damage your gums or other teeth. Contact us
  today if you feel any discomfort caused by your implants.

# Statistics thatsave lives

We examine the evidence behind questions that affect people’s lives, empowering everyone to make
better decisions

### We change lives
### and systems

Two thirds of new World Health Organization guidelines in the past 5 years cite at least 1 Cochrane
review. [Read about our impact][23].

### Our evidence
### is trusted

Scientists, policymakers and decision-makers turn to us for evidence they can rely on. [Learn why
our evidence is trusted][24].

### We collaborate
### globally

We produce outstanding evidence by collaborating with a wide range of experts and members of the
public. [Get involved][25].

## [News][26]
* [ ][27]
  
  [Exercise helps hip arthritis pain, but perhaps less than we thought][28]
  
  23 July 2026
  
  A new Cochrane review finds that exercise may improve pain and function, but the benefits may fall
  short of what patients would notice in daily life.
* [ ][29]
  
  [Why evidence synthesis matters in the age of AI][30]
  
  22 July 2026
  
  In an era defined by an abundance of information, and new ways to find it, Cochrane’s Chief
  Executive Officer, Karla Soares-Weiser argues that systematic reviews remain an essential tool to
  help individuals, healthcare professionals and policymakers make decisions. However, the challenge
  is no longer simply producing reliable evidence but maintaining the trust that makes Cochrane’s
  evidence useful.
* [ ][31]
  
  [Building a volunteer network through Cochrane Engage][32]
  
  16 July 2026
  
  Knowledge translation (KT) is a key part of ensuring that high-quality evidence reaches the people
  who can use it. In Italy, however, research methods and evidence-based medicine (EBM) are not
  consistently integrated into higher education or medical education programmes.
* [ ][33]
  
  [World Evidence-based Healthcare Day launches its 2026 campaign][34]
  
  24 June 2026
  
  Today an international coalition of organizations dedicated to evidence-informed decision-making
  launched the World Evidence-based Healthcare Day 2026 campaign, ‘Evidence and AI: People at the
  Centre’.

[More news][35]

# Retrouvez le sourire avec Dentaly

À travers nos pages, découvrez les meilleures options de soins dentaires en France. Votre santé
dentaire est primordiale. C'est pourquoi nous sommes là pour vous conseiller et vous guider.
[ En savoir plus ][177]

## Nos produits les plus prisés

Orthodontie invisible Dr Smile
[Aligneurs dentaires Home page][Aligneurs dentaires Home page]
[ Découvrir ces aligneurs dentaires ][178]
Comparateur de mutuelles dentaires
[comparateur mutuelles][comparateur mutuelles]
[ Trouver la meilleure mutuelle dentaire ][179]
Brosse à dents électrique My Variations
[My Variations][My Variations]
[ Découvrir cette brosse à dents électrique ][180]
[appareils dentaires et orthodontie][appareils dentaires et orthodontie]

## [ Orthodontie ][181]

Si vous envisagez d'entamer un traitement orthodontique, que ce soit pour vous-même ou votre enfant,
vous êtes confronté.e à une décision importante. Actuellement, de multiples types d’appareils
dentaires sont disponibles, rendant le choix considérable, mais tout aussi difficile. Les appareils
dentaires invisibles sont très prisés en raison de leur discrétion, mais ils ne constituent pas la
seule alternative aux appareils métalliques conventionnels. Nous vous invitons à consulter notre
guide afin d'explorer les avantages et les inconvénients des différents types d'appareils dentaires,
ainsi que de vous informer sur leurs coûts en France.
[ Aligneur dentaire Comment fonctionne l'orthodontie invisible ? Traitements et prix des gouttières
transparentes ][182]
[ Appareil lingual Tout savoir sur l'orthodontie linguale : traitements, prix, et avis de ces
appareils discrets ][183]
[ Bagues dentaires Bagues en métal, en céramique ou transparentes : notre guide sur cet appareil
classique ][184]
[ Appareil dentaire pour enfant Pourquoi suivre un traitement orthodontique dès l'enfance ?
Retrouvez nos articles dédiés ][185]
[dentisterie esthétique][dentisterie esthétique]

## Esthétique dentaire

De nombreuses personnes ne se sentent pas à l'aise avec leur sourire, et ce, pour diverses raisons.
Si l'aspect de vos dents — qu'elles soient désalignées, cassées ou mal positionnées — vous
préoccupe, envisager la dentisterie esthétique peut être une excellente solution. Ou peut-être,
souhaitez-vous tout simplement retrouver un sourire éclatant ? Dans ce cas, vous devrez choisir
entre un blanchiment dentaire à réaliser en cabinet ou opter pour des kits de blanchiment à
domicile. Dès lors, renseignez-vous sur les différentes options et leur coût afin de décider ce qui
vous convient le mieux.
[ Dentisterie esthétique Facettes, blanchiment dentaire, prothèses... découvrez toutes nos solutions
esthétiques. ][186]
[ Blanchiment dentaire Blanchiment dentaire en cabinet ou à domicile, découvrez toutes nos méthodes
blancheur ][187]
[ Facettes dentaires Types de facettes, prix, avantages et inconvénients. ][188]
[ Kits de blanchiment dentaire Les meilleurs kits de blanchiment dentaire à domicile ][189]
[restauration dentaire][restauration dentaire]

## [ Restauration dentaire ][190]

Si vous souffrez d'une dent endommagée ou absente, diverses solutions peuvent vous aider à restaurer
ou remplacer votre dent. Les implants dentaires se distinguent comme la solution la plus pérenne
pour remplacer une dent manquante, bien qu'ils représentent également l'option la plus onéreuse.
D'autres possibilités, telles que les prothèses dentaires et les bridges, offrent une solution plus
économique, mais peuvent comporter certains désavantages. Ce guide vous fournira toutes les
informations nécessaires pour évaluer les différentes options et prendre une décision éclairée
concernant le traitement le plus adapté à vos besoins.
[ Implant dentaire Procédures, coûts et types d'implants dentaires ][191]
[ Couronne dentaire Procédures, coûts et types de couronnes dentaires ][192]
[ Bridge dentaire Procédures, coûts et types de bridges dentaires ][193]
[veneers istanbul][veneers istanbul]

## Tourisme dentaire

Franchir les frontières de l'hexagone pour bénéficier de soins dentaires moins chers, c'est le choix
d'un nombre croissant de patient.e.s français.e.s. L'idée vous séduit, mais vous aimeriez en savoir
plus sur cette tendance ? Découvrez avec nous les destinations les plus populaires ainsi que toutes
les informations pratiques pour réaliser vos soins en toute sécurité. Nos équipes collaborent avec
des cliniques dentaires réputées en Hongrie et en Turquie.
[ Tout savoir sur le tourisme dentaire Les meilleurs pays pour réaliser des soins dentaires moins
chers de qualité ][194]
[ Tourisme dentaire en Hongrie Les meilleures cliniques, les procédures et les coûts des traitements
dentaires en Hongrie ][195]
[ Tourisme dentaire en Turquie Les meilleures cliniques, les procédures et les coûts des traitements
dentaires en Truquie ][196]
[hygiène dentaire][hygiène dentaire]

À travers nos pages, découvrez les meilleures options de soins dentaires en France. Votre santé
dentaire est primordiale. C'est pourquoi nous sommes là pour vous conseiller et vous guider.

## [ Orthodontie ][181]

Si vous envisagez d'entamer un traitement orthodontique, que ce soit pour vous-même ou votre enfant,
vous êtes confronté.e à une décision importante. Actuellement, de multiples types d’appareils
dentaires sont disponibles, rendant le choix considérable, mais tout aussi difficile. Les appareils
dentaires invisibles sont très prisés en raison de leur discrétion, mais ils ne constituent pas la
seule alternative aux appareils métalliques conventionnels. Nous vous invitons à consulter notre
guide afin d'explorer les avantages et les inconvénients des différents types d'appareils dentaires,
ainsi que de vous informer sur leurs coûts en France.
[ Aligneur dentaire Comment fonctionne l'orthodontie invisible ? Traitements et prix des gouttières
transparentes ][182]
[ Appareil lingual Tout savoir sur l'orthodontie linguale : traitements, prix, et avis de ces
appareils discrets ][183]
[ Bagues dentaires Bagues en métal, en céramique ou transparentes : notre guide sur cet appareil
classique ][184]

Retrouvez nos articles dédiés ][185]
[dentisterie esthétique][dentisterie esthétique]

## Esthétique dentaire

De nombreuses personnes ne se sentent pas à l'aise avec leur sourire, et ce, pour diverses raisons.
Si l'aspect de vos dents — qu'elles soient désalignées, cassées ou mal positionnées — vous
préoccupe, envisager la dentisterie esthétique peut être une excellente solution. Ou peut-être,
souhaitez-vous tout simplement retrouver un sourire éclatant ? Dans ce cas, vous devrez choisir
entre un blanchiment dentaire à réaliser en cabinet ou opter pour des kits de blanchiment à
domicile. Dès lors, renseignez-vous sur les différentes options et leur coût afin de décider ce qui
vous convient le mieux.
[ Dentisterie esthétique Facettes, blanchiment dentaire, prothèses... découvrez toutes nos solutions
esthétiques. ][186]
[ Blanchiment dentaire Blanchiment dentaire en cabinet ou à domicile, découvrez toutes nos méthodes
blancheur ][187]
[ Facettes dentaires Types de facettes, prix, avantages et inconvénients. ][188]
[ Kits de blanchiment dentaire Les meilleurs kits de blanchiment dentaire à domicile ][189]
[restauration dentaire][restauration dentaire]

## [ Restauration dentaire ][190]

Si vous souffrez d'une dent endommagée ou absente, diverses solutions peuvent vous aider à restaurer
ou remplacer votre dent. Les implants dentaires se distinguent comme la solution la plus pérenne
pour remplacer une dent manquante, bien qu'ils représentent également l'option la plus onéreuse.
D'autres possibilités, telles que les prothèses dentaires et les bridges, offrent une solution plus
économique, mais peuvent comporter certains désavantages. Ce guide vous fournira toutes les
informations nécessaires pour évaluer les différentes options et prendre une décision éclairée
concernant le traitement le plus adapté à vos besoins.

## THE DENISON DIFFERENCE

Denison Family & Cosmetic Dentistry provides compassionate, comprehensive dental care in [Newport
News, VA][33]. Whether you are looking for general preventive care or are in need of cosmetic
treatments, dentures or sleep apnea treatment, we offer a full range of dental services. From the
minute you walk into our dental office you will notice a difference at Denison Dentistry. Our
Newport News dentist, John Denison, D.D.S. and his team care about you and your family, and we’re
here to help you achieve your healthiest, brightest smile. Denison Dentistry is part of the
[Atlantic Dental Care][34] Group, which is a group of local dentists and dental offices in Hampton
Roads that share a vision to provide quality care and are committed to helping the community and
their patients.

## MEET YOUR NEWPORT NEWS DENTIST
## DR. JOHN DENISON

Dr. Denison earned his Bachelor of Science in Biology at Florida State University and went on to
pursue his Doctor of Dental Surgery from the Medical College of Virginia School of Dentistry. Dr.
Denison places a strong emphasis on continuing education and he and his staff have attended many
courses regarding state-of-the-art treatments in dentistry, including extensive training in
Cosmetic, Restorative and Computerized Dentistry. He has been utilizing the state-of-the-art Cerec
CAD/CAM Instrument for over 15 years. Dr. Denison has also trained in the use of oral appliances for
sleep apnea.

Dr. Denison believes that going to dental school was one of the best decisions he has ever made. He
loves all aspects of his job. He enjoys working with people, running the business and doing the
dentistry. He became involved in dentistry after realizing it would allow him to combine his
creative side and his scientific knowledge. One of his favorite parts of the job is seeing the
finished results of treatments that transform a person from having poor oral health to having a
beautiful functional smile. Dr. Denison finds it so rewarding to see that patient’s reaction when
they first see and realize the results.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

Envista's Equipment & Consumables segment develops and manufactures dental equipment and consumable
supplies used in dental offices, including digital imaging systems, dental practice equipment,
endodontic systems, restorative and impression materials, bonding agents and cements, and infection
prevention products.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Finding Manufacturers

### How do I find a manufacturer for my product?

Finding the right manufacturer starts with knowing exactly what you need. Define your product
specifications, target price point, and required certifications before you begin outreach. From
there, search by product category on a B2B sourcing platform like Find My Manufacturer, where you
can filter manufacturers by certifications, minimum order quantity, location, and production
capability.

Cross-reference any manufacturer you find across multiple sources, review their profile for
verifiable details, and always request a sample before committing to a full production run.
Referrals from industry contacts and trade show connections can also surface manufacturers who do
not actively advertise online.

The sourcing process typically takes 4 to 12 weeks from first contact to confirmed partner,
depending on your product category and customization requirements.

### How much does it cost to work with a private label or contract manufacturer?

Manufacturing costs vary widely based on product category, order volume, customization level,
material inputs, and the manufacturer’s location. For private label products, costs generally
include a per-unit production fee, packaging and labeling costs, and in some cases a setup or
tooling fee for custom molds or packaging formats. For contract manufacturing, additional costs may
include formulation development, testing, and regulatory compliance depending on the product
category.

Most manufacturers set a minimum order quantity (MOQ) that directly affects your per-unit cost –
higher volumes consistently reduce the cost per unit. As a benchmark, supplement private label MOQs
typically start around 1,000 to 2,500 units, apparel manufacturers often start at 300 to 500 pieces
per style, and food manufacturing MOQs vary from 500 to 5,000 units depending on the format.

The most reliable way to understand real costs for your specific product is to submit quote requests
to multiple manufacturers and compare. Find My Manufacturer allows you to do this directly, free,
with no broker fees or commission added.

### What is the difference between private label and contract manufacturing?

Private label manufacturing and contract manufacturing are the two most common models for brands
sourcing physical products, and choosing the wrong one can add months and significant cost to your
launch.

In private label manufacturing, the manufacturer already produces an existing base product or
formula. You select it, apply your branding, and sell it under your own name. This model is faster,
lower cost, and lower risk, making it well suited for brands entering a new category, testing
product-market fit, or launching with limited capital.

Contract manufacturing works differently. The brand provides detailed product specifications, a
proprietary formula, or a custom design, and the manufacturer produces it exactly to those
requirements. The brand typically owns the intellectual property, the formulation, and the product
design. This model gives you a genuinely differentiated product that competitors cannot easily
replicate, but it requires more upfront investment in development, testing, and tooling.

The right model depends on three factors: how much product differentiation you need, how quickly you
need to go to market, and what your development budget allows. Many brands start with private label
to validate demand, then transition to contract manufacturing once they have a proven product and
customer base.

options across every product category.

design. This model gives you a genuinely differentiated product that competitors cannot easily
replicate, but it requires more upfront investment in development, testing, and tooling.

need to go to market, and what your development budget allows. Many brands start with private label
to validate demand, then transition to contract manufacturing once they have a proven product and
customer base.

planning for your smile’s future. After over a decade in dentistry, he’s built a practice around a
deep respect for each patient's individual needs. Whether it’s a routine cleaning or a complex
implant case, Dr. Aaron works to make your dental journey smoother, more predictable, and far less

Sparrow’s patient-centered approach combines his commitment to precision, aesthetics, and
compassionate care. Whether it’s preventive care or complex procedures, he treats every patient with
the same care he’d offer family.

Maria S.

This was my first time here and I felt so welcomed, so seen and so comfortable. Going to the dentist

made me feel so seen, the entire interaction just put me in such a great mood and I’m so glad I

Joyce K.

We came to Garden City Dental for a second opinion, and Dr. Huang was incredibly patient. He clearly
explained everything, thoroughly answered all of our questions, and made sure we fully understood

Jeffrey W.

The staff was very kind and professional. They cared about my comfort and were very clear and
communicative. I will recommend Garden City Dental to everyone.

Deborah E.

Garden City Dental is a wonderful, caring place. Their motto is: "We believe kind, quality dental
care is a human right," and they live by that. All of the staff and both dentists are so kind and

Dr. Aaron, Jordan and the staff at Garden City were an absolute pleasure to work with!

### Your smile. Our responsibility.

### Welcome to Garden City Dental

# Your Vancouver dentist for quality-driven care

At Garden City Dental, we know that great dental care is a right, not a privilege. No matter your
budget, insurance, or dental history, our mission is to provide thoughtful, patient-centered care
that focuses on your long-term oral health. With advanced tools like CBCT imaging and a team that
genuinely listens, our goal is simple: to make every visit comfortable, confident, and stress-free
for you.

### Meet Your Doctor

## Get to know Dr. Aaron Huang

With more than 12 years of experience, Dr. Aaron Huang isn’t just about fixing teeth; he's about
planning for your smile’s future. After over a decade in dentistry, he’s built a practice around a
deep respect for each patient's individual needs. Whether it’s a routine cleaning or a complex
implant case, Dr. Aaron works to make your dental journey smoother, more predictable, and far less
stressful. His calm, friendly nature and passion for problem-solving make every treatment plan
clear, thoughtful, and personalized.

[
Learn More
][39]

### Meet Your Doctor

## Get to Know Dr. Michael Sparrow

Dr. Michael Sparrow, a proud native of McMinnville, Oregon, has a deep-rooted passion for dentistry
that began in his father’s dental lab. After earning his Bachelor of Science in Biology from Oregon
State University, he went on to graduate with honors from the OHSU School of Dentistry in 2012. Dr.
Sparrow’s patient-centered approach combines his commitment to precision, aesthetics, and
compassionate care. Whether it’s preventive care or complex procedures, he treats every patient with
the same care he’d offer family.

[
Learn More
][40]

## Care that’s focused on your future

[
Schedule Today
][41]

### Dental implants

We offer expertly placed and restored [dental implants][42], planned from day one with detailed
imaging and strategy. Designed to last, our implants give you a natural-looking, fully functional
smile you can count on.

[
Learn More
][43]

### Emergency dentistry

Dental problems don’t wait, and neither should you. We offer same-day availability whenever possible
to get you back to feeling better, fast. Exams and digital imaging help us relieve pain and address
the issue quickly.

[
Learn More
][44]

### Preventative dentistry

Routine exams and cleanings are the foundation of a healthy smile. We focus on early detection,
gentle hygiene care, and personalized guidance to help you maintain long-term oral health with
visits that feel easy and proactive.

[
Learn More
][45]

## Why Garden City Dental?

We don’t believe in rushed, one-size-fits-all dentistry. At Garden City Dental, you’ll find a team
that takes time to understand you, and a philosophy that puts your lifetime oral health first. From
advanced comfort amenities to in-depth consultations for complex cases, our approach is built around
clarity, trust, and long-term solutions. [Contact our office][46] or book your first appointment
online!

[
Learn More
][47]

### Plan for your journey

We're not just treating today's issue, we're building a roadmap for your healthiest smile. Our team
takes the time to help you understand what’s ahead, so you'll always feel in control and
well-informed about your care.

### Comfort-focused amenities

From TVs on the ceiling and wireless headphones to massaging, heated chairs and a cozy coffee
station, we’ve designed every detail for your relaxation.

### Commitment to precision

Our advanced 3D CBCT imaging allows us to plan implant procedures with exceptional accuracy. This
technology helps us diagnose more clearly, place implants more precisely, and create safer, more
predictable outcomes.

### Sedation for peace of mind

We’re one of the few practices in the area offering IV sedation, ideal for anxious patients or
complex procedures. Feel calm, relaxed, and cared for from start to finish.

## New patient special offer

We’re here to welcome new patients with offers that put your care, and your wallet, at ease. Whether
you’re overdue for a checkup or in need of a cleaning, we’ve got you covered. Keep in mind both
offers can be converted to a Wellness Plan.

## Family & Cosmetic Dentist

At Great Lakes Dental Care, our [Grand Rapids dentists][85] and experienced dental team are
committed to providing our patients with high-quality care in an open, caring and nurturing
environment. Using advanced technology and modern dental procedures, our knowledgeable and
professional dentists strive to make your visit easy, safe and comfortable.

Our [Grand Rapids dentists][86] — Dr. Travis Kragt, Dr. Sarah De Zwaan, Dr. Drew De Zwaan, Dr.
Brenden Carey, Dr. Nicole Vince, Dr. Alyssa Marsh, Dr. Hannah Vermeer, Dr. Jason Sassack, and Dr.
Emma King — offer patients a superior level of treatment and customer service by combining modern
techniques and state-of-the-art [technology][87] with proven treatment methods.

[Apply for CareCredit][88][Contact Us][89]

### Our Dental Services

At Implant Center of Miami, we are proud to provide a multitude of restorative, cosmetic, and
preventative dental services:

[[Dental implants]][82]

### [Dental Implants][83]

Dental implants are strong, durable, and natural-looking teeth replacements that can last for 20
years or more with the proper care. We offer dental implants for only $1789!

[ Learn More ][84]
[[Dentures]][85]

### [Dentures][86]

Dentures are essentially false teeth that are custom made to fit your mouth perfectly. They can be
used to replace a single tooth, multiple teeth, or even a full set of teeth.

[ Learn More ][87]
[[Invisalign®]][88]

### [Invisalign®][89]

Invisalign® is clear, custom, plastic aligners created to align a patient's teeth over the span of a
few months or years. This treatment is known to be a popular and effective solution!

[ Learn More ][90]
[[BOTOX® dentistry]][91]

### [BOTOX® Dentistry][92]

BOTOX® dentistry is the use of botulinum toxin to temporarily reduce or eliminate wrinkles in the
facial area. It can also be used to treat TMJ disorders and teeth grinding.

[ Learn More ][93]
[[Emergency]][94]

### [Emergency Services][95]

There are a few different types of dental emergencies that require different types of treatment. If
you have a tooth that has been knocked out or a toothache, come see us!

[ Learn More ][96]
[[Cosmetic]][97]

### [Cosmetic Dentistry][98]

Cosmetic dentistry is about improving the function of your teeth in a way that also leaves your
pearly whites looking bright and beautiful. From whitening to veneers, we do it all!

[ Learn More ][99]

## Health Beyond Smiles

We believe dental care should do more than just make your teeth look good. At Metro Dental, we focus
on prevention, finding the root of the problem before it affects your health.

Misaligned teeth can shift your jaw, narrow your airway, affect digestion, and even strain your
posture. Poor oral health is also linked to heart disease and inflammation.

We use advanced diagnostics and a well-trained team in our dental clinics to catch issues early
before they become bigger problems that impact your health.

[Learn More][34]
[A professional reception area at Metro Dental office, showcasing a well-lit space with contemporary
furniture and a welcoming ambiance.]

## 
## Invisalign

### 
###  Precision Meets Wellness

Invisalign,  the world’s most advanced clear aligner system, is backed by data from over 20 million
smiles and powered by AI-driven planning tools that move teeth with precision and purpose. This
isn’t just about straightening, it’s about improving your overall health.

Aligned teeth support better jaw position, more efficient chewing and digestion, clearer speech, and
even easier breathing.

As a Diamond Tier Provider and one of the top Invisalign clinics in the Philippines, Metro Dental
delivers expert care with a health-first approach you can trust. You can have confidence that our
dentists in Metro Manila are trained to help you achieve your perfect smile using state-of-the-art
technology.

[More Information][35]

# 
# Mall-based Dental Clinics, Always Open for You

Metro Dental has four conveniently located dentist clinics inside top malls across Metro Manila —
making it easy to find a dental clinic near you.

We’re open daily until 8:00 PM, including weekends and most holidays, so you can get the care you
need on your schedule. Whether you're booking a routine checkup or a more advanced consultation, our
dental clinics in Metro Manila are designed for convenience, comfort, and accessibility.

We believe every smile tells a story — let yours shine with confidence.

We know that a perfect smile can make a lasting impression and this is exactly the reason why we’re
here. Our patients can enjoy comprehensive dental services as we are committed to giving you the
highest quality care.

We employ technologies and techniques to make your every visit worth it. As soon as you enter our
clinic, we will ensure that you’ll remain comfortable and well taken care of. With us, you’ll have
the peace of mind that you’ll only get the best care and treatment for your teeth!

## Health Beyond Smiles

We believe dental care should do more than just make your teeth look good. At Metro Dental, we focus
on prevention, finding the root of the problem before it affects your health.

Misaligned teeth can shift your jaw, narrow your airway, affect digestion, and even strain your
posture. Poor oral health is also linked to heart disease and inflammation.

We use advanced diagnostics and a well-trained team in our dental clinics to catch issues early
before they become bigger problems that impact your health.

[Learn More][34]

## Invisalign

###  Precision Meets Wellness

Invisalign,  the world’s most advanced clear aligner system, is backed by data from over 20 million
smiles and powered by AI-driven planning tools that move teeth with precision and purpose. This
isn’t just about straightening, it’s about improving your overall health.

Aligned teeth support better jaw position, more efficient chewing and digestion, clearer speech, and
even easier breathing.

As a Diamond Tier Provider and one of the top Invisalign clinics in the Philippines, Metro Dental
delivers expert care with a health-first approach you can trust. You can have confidence that our
dentists in Metro Manila are trained to help you achieve your perfect smile using state-of-the-art
technology.

## Get some #ElfHelp for your project

[Elves understand research]

### Your research deserves more readers than it’s getting
* Most published research never reaches the patients, clinicians, practitioners, and policymakers
  who need to act on it
* Standard university comms reach your existing network, not the people who need to change their
  practice
* [Learn more about our Elf Help services][365]

### Commission the Mental Elf to help you disseminate your work
* We can help you develop the strategy, content, social media, webinars, podcasts and blogs
* We’ve been building trusted audiences in mental health research since 2011, now funded by the
  Wellcome Trust
* [Learn how we can build a learning ladder to your research][366]

### Already working with the UK’s leading research universities
* Our academic partners include Oxford, UCL, KCL, Sheffield, Bristol, Lancaster, Exeter and more
* A handful of top research projects

# The Voice for Dentistry in Nova Scotia

[ Learn more about NSDA ][96]
[ NSDA Membership Application ][97]

[The Nova Scotia Dental Association (NSDA) is a member-based organization serving the needs of more
than 600 dentist members across the province. The Dental Association Act (2024) requires all
licensed dentists in Nova Scotia to be members of the NSDA.][98]

## Oral Health Report

Get the 2026 Nova Scotia Oral Health Report*:[ Strengthening Oral-Systemic Integration][102]*,
produced by the Nova Scotia Dental Association.

The 2026 Oral Health Report focuses on the need for greater integration between oral health and the
broader health care system and outlines key recommendations to improve coordination, access, and
patient outcomes across Nova Scotia.

## A Beautiful Smile Is Your Gateway to Overall Well-Being

Our approach to wellness starts with the mouth. The link between the mouth and body holds the key to
optimal health and longevity, and this is the foundation of Biologic Dentistry. Unlike conventional
dentistry, which is mostly geared towards treating symptoms, Biologic Dentistry looks at the whole
person to evaluate health and wellness needs.

[Meet Dr. Curatola][162]

### Global Pioneer

Regarded as the “Father of Modern Biologic Dentistry,” Dr. Curatola leads with over 41 years of
innovative restorative and cosmetic practice.

### Champion of Global Health

From building a dental hospital in India to partnering with Fran Drescher’s Cancer Schmancer, his
humanitarian work spans the globe.

### Educator and Author

Clinical Associate Professor at NYU and author of The Mouth-Body Connection™, redefining
oral-systemic health.

### Leader in Integrative Health

A driving force on prestigious health boards, Dr. Curatola shapes the future of biologic and
holistic dentistry on an international scale.

### International Speaker

Invited to present at prestigious events such as the Vatican Scientific Conference, the
International Congress of Integrative Medicine, and the World Economic Forum.

### Inventor and Award-Winning Innovator

Creator of Revitin, the first prebiotic toothpaste backed by 20+ years of microbiome research, and
recipient of the Acton Medal from NYU and The Humanitarian Award.

# Dentistry

Dr. Gerry Curatola has redefined dentistry to support whole-body health with the establishment of
the Curatola Institute to further the study and application of the principles of biologic dentistry.

## Today, We Celebrate 40+ Years of Innovation

### It’s 1983

Dr. Gerry Curatola sets out to unite dentistry and medicine, removing the illogical 150-year-old
wall between the two.

[Rejuvenation Dentistry logo from 1983] [Dr. Gerry Curatola]

### It’s 2006

Dr. Curatola launches Rejuvenation Dentistry, further solidifying his position as “The Father of
Biologic Dentistry.”

[Rejuvenation Dentistry logo from 2006] [Dr. Gerry Curatola]

### It’s 2017

Rejuvenation Dentistry unveils a global vision, as Dr. Curatola’s The Mouth-Body Connection™
redefines holistic care.

[Rejuvenation Dentistry logo from 2017] [Dr. Gerry Curatola]

### It’s 2025

And Rejuvenation Dentistry has become a revolution in wellness. Dr. Curatola’s vision continues to
inspire transformation, raising the bar for health worldwide.

[Rejuvenation Dentistry logo from 2025] [Dr. Gerry Curatola]

### The Present Day

The seeds of rejuvenation bloom into a bold new mark. This year also marks the launch of The
Curatola Institute, a foundation committed to elevating care on a global scale.

## A Beautiful Smile Is Your Gateway to Overall Well-Being

Our approach to wellness starts with the mouth. The link between the mouth and body holds the key to
optimal health and longevity, and this is the foundation of Biologic Dentistry. Unlike conventional
dentistry, which is mostly geared towards treating symptoms, Biologic Dentistry looks at the whole
person to evaluate health and wellness needs.

## The Father of Modern Biologic Dentistry Redefining Oral Health and Wellness Through Holistic
## Innovation

[Meet Dr. Curatola][162]

### Global Pioneer

Regarded as the “Father of Modern Biologic Dentistry,” Dr. Curatola leads with over 41 years of
innovative restorative and cosmetic practice.

### Champion of Global Health

From building a dental hospital in India to partnering with Fran Drescher’s Cancer Schmancer, his
humanitarian work spans the globe.

### Educator and Author

Clinical Associate Professor at NYU and author of The Mouth-Body Connection™, redefining
oral-systemic health.

### Leader in Integrative Health

A driving force on prestigious health boards, Dr. Curatola shapes the future of biologic and
holistic dentistry on an international scale.

### International Speaker

Invited to present at prestigious events such as the Vatican Scientific Conference, the
International Congress of Integrative Medicine, and the World Economic Forum.

### Inventor and Award-Winning Innovator

Creator of Revitin, the first prebiotic toothpaste backed by 20+ years of microbiome research, and
recipient of the Acton Medal from NYU and The Humanitarian Award.

active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

Dr. Lynn is our pediatric specialist and he prioritizes patient experience above all else, going

At SmileLYNN Pediatric Dentistry, pediatric dentistry is done differently. Our friendly and
experienced staff spends ample time with each child and ensures they are educated on the importance

and preventative measures with positive overall wellness.

health and a positive association with the dentist. We promote parents to be a part of their child’s

specialist, Dr. Lynn, takes the time to make both the child and the parent comfortable during the
process.

provide the most efficient and pain-free experience for each patient. Our pediatric offices near you

## Your Pediatric Dental Specialists

Are you looking for pediatric dentist near you? Right from their first visit, keeping your child’s
smiles as strong, beautiful, and healthy as possible is as important to us as it is to you. With
that in mind, Dr. Lynn and Dr. Stewart constantly strives to provide the best oral health care in a
friendly and comfortable environment for our precious patients of all ages. [Schedule an
appointment][53] with our pediatric dentist near you.

A lifetime of clean, healthy, strong, and beautiful smiles starts here. Trust your child’s dental
care and oral health to a certified specialist. For more information, book a consultation and visit
our pediatric dentist office near you today!

# Why Choose Our Kids Dentist Near You?

[kid friendly dental office][kid friendly dental office]

## Kid-Friendly Dental Office

Dr. Lynn is our pediatric specialist and he prioritizes patient experience above all else, going
above and beyond to provide a great experience for each child. Our office provides a calming beach
theme with toys, ipads, books, and big screen TVs above every chair. Each child has the ability to
watch their favorite show while getting their cleaning done.

[educate on oral health][educate on oral health]

## We Educate on Oral Health

At SmileLYNN Pediatric Dentistry, pediatric dentistry is done differently. Our friendly and
experienced staff spends ample time with each child and ensures they are educated on the importance
of oral health and good oral hygiene practices. We take the time to help them associate dentistry
and preventative measures with positive overall wellness.

[make comfortable during process][make comfortable during process]

## Parents are Our Partners

We believe that the parents of each child are important partners in helping us achieve good oral
health and a positive association with the dentist. We promote parents to be a part of their child’s
dental goals and experience, allowing them to sit in for their dental treatments. Our pediatric
specialist, Dr. Lynn, takes the time to make both the child and the parent comfortable during the
process.

[pain free dental treatment][pain free dental treatment]

## Pain-Free Dental Treatment

Our office implements advanced technology where possible, such as the LightScalpel CO2 Laser, to
provide the most efficient and pain-free experience for each patient. Our pediatric offices near you
also offers Nitrous Oxide in a few fun flavors to make the experience even more relaxing. If you
have questions about these options, contact our office and we will be happy to answer them!

[Welcome to UMGROUP Dental Supplies ][177]

Tangshan umg medical instrument co ltd. (UMG) is one of the main wholesale dental lab supplies in
China. UMG dental unit china is group company and has R&D, production and sales teams for various
dental products, for example, wholesale dental chair, dental instrument china, wholesale dental unit
and so on. Our china dental supply products are dental equipment, dental consumables, dental
simulators, dental instruments and so on. In addition, as one of the professional dental instruments
companies in china, we continue to work hard to update and develop new products, such as oral care
products, dental laboratory equipment & furniture, dental models and other china dental products.
With ten years of experience in the export trade of wholesale dental equipment and OEM experience,
